transitions.action: Send Start-Control-Connection-Request

transitions.event: Receive Start Ctl Connection Reply Version OK
transitions.action: moves to the established state

transitions.event: Receive Start Ctl Connection Reply Version Not OK
transitions.action: Send Stop-Control-Connection-Request... moves into the wait_stop_reply state
send a Stop-Control-Connection-Request and enter the wait_stop_reply state
TCP connection SHOULD be closed and the control connection becomes idle

transitions.event: Receive Start Control Connection Request Version OK
transitions.action: send a Start-Control-Connection-Reply... enter the established state

transitions.event: Receive Start Control Connection Request Version Not Supported
transitions.action: close the TCP connection and remain in the idle state
send a Stop-Control-Connection-Reply... close the TCP connection
moves to the wait_reply state
send an Incoming-Call-Connected message and enters the established state

transitions.event: Receive Incoming Call Reply Not Accepting
transitions.action: moves back into the idle state

transitions.event: Receive Clear Call Request / telco call dropped / local disconnect
transitions.action: Send Call Disconnect Notify... moves back to idle
send an Incoming-Call-Reply indicating accept... session moves to the wait_connect state
moves into established state

transitions.event: Send Call Clear Request / Receive Disconnect Notify
transitions.action: session enters the wait_disconnect state
session moves back to the idle state
Place the outbound call... move to the wait_cs_ans state
Send Outgoing Call Reply. ... enter established state
Send Outgoing Call Reply with Error... Hangup call and send Call Disconnect Notify
Hangup call and send Call Disconnect Notify
session moves into the wait_reply state

transitions.event: Receive Outgoing Call Reply No Error
transitions.action: telco call is connected and the session moves to the established state

transitions.event: Receive Outgoing Call Reply with Error
transitions.action: session returns to idle state

transitions.event: Local Terminate / Send Call Clear Request
transitions.action: sends a Call-Clear-Request... enters the wait_disconnect state
session enters idle state
